name: @arena/expert-session-policy-service
description: Arena expert session policy reference service (Work Order C018; issue #124). Tenant-scoped policy pack registration with typed closed validation verdicts, effective-policy resolution binding an EscalationRequest's policy fields to the applicable pack and handing the concrete policy to the C006 session builder and C007 mode guards through injected ports (resolution owns, enforcement borrows), the retention disposition engine (expiry sweeps, expert withdrawal, customer erasure — double-spend safe), explicit cross-tenant pack reuse authorization, and an append-only tamper-evident audit trail over every apply/redact/mask/deny decision.
